description:
Clever Cleaner – The Best Free iPhone Cleaner App!

Looking for a truly free iPhone cleaner app with no annoying ads and no mandatory subscription? Meet Clever Cleaner: generous free daily limits let you clean up your iPhone without paying a cent. From the creators of Disk Drill, the #1 Mac data recovery app.

In just a few taps, delete duplicate and similar photos, remove large videos, clear out old screenshots, convert Live Photos to still images, and free up space on your iPhone, all in one iPhone storage cleaning app.

WHY CHOOSE CLEVER CLEANER?
• All the main tools you need to free up iPhone storage quickly and easily.
• No need to go Premium: the free daily limits give you plenty of room for regular cleanups.
• No ads, pop-ups, or other distractions while you use our iPhone cleanup app.

Clever Cleaner can help:

DELETE DUPLICATE AND SIMILAR PHOTOS
Need an app to delete duplicate photos on iPhone? With a careful AI scan, Clever Cleaner finds duplicate and similar photos on iPhone, puts them into groups, and marks the Best Shot. Choose what to remove or select everything, and enjoy an organized photo library.

FIND LARGE VIDEOS
Clever Cleaner sorts videos by size, from largest to smallest, so you can quickly delete the biggest ones or compress videos you'd rather keep.

REMOVE UNNEEDED SCREENSHOTS
Clever Cleaner gathers your screenshots in one place and lets you sort them by newest, oldest, or largest. Delete screenshots you no longer need, or compress the ones you want to keep.

CONVERT LIVE PHOTOS TO STILL IMAGES
Don't need the video part of a Live Photo? Clever Cleaner converts it into a regular still photo that takes up less space. You can also delete Live Photos entirely.

COMPRESS YOUR MEDIA
Not ready to delete anything? Compress and free up iPhone space without giving your media up. Clever Cleaner works with videos, photos, screenshots, and Live Photos.

CLEAN UP WITH SWIPE
A good iPhone photo cleanup app should let you decide for yourself, so there's Swipe: go through photos, videos, screenshots, and Live Photos one by one. Swipe left to delete, right to keep. And Swipe has no daily limit.

REMOVE MEDIA JUNK IN ONE TAP
Tired of the "iPhone storage full" warning? You don't need a dozen tools, just one app to clean up iPhone storage. Smart Cleanup removes duplicate and similar photos while keeping the Best Shot, compresses screenshots, and deletes the live part from all photos on iPhone. Run one, two, or all three at once to get gigabytes of space back.

YOUR MEDIA STAYS PRIVATE
• Everything is processed locally: your photos and videos stay on your device.
• Add any photo or video to the Skip List to leave it out of cleanup.
• Deleted media goes to Recently Deleted in Photos, so you can review and restore it if needed.

WHY IS CLEVER CLEANER THE BEST FREE PHONE CLEANER APP FOR IPHONE?
• A rare combination of powerful cleanup tools and truly generous free daily limits.
• Lightweight and user-friendly, it's the perfect phone cleaner for iOS devices.

Whether you're trying to free up space, delete duplicate pictures, or clear your iPhone storage on a larger scale, Clever Cleaner is the best free camera roll cleaner for iPhone.

BEST CLEANER APP FOR IPAD
Clever Cleaner works seamlessly on iPad in compatibility mode, offering the same powerful features as on iPhone.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Clever Cleaner is free to download and use within generous daily limits. To remove the limits, choose one of the Premium options: a weekly plan with a 3-day free trial, a yearly plan, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Payment for the weekly plan will be charged to your Apple ID account at the end of the 3-day free trial unless the trial is canceled at least 24 hours before it ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://www.cleverfiles.com/help/clever-cleaner-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.cleverfiles.com/help/clever-cleaner-terms-of-service.html
